Nothing is edited or run before I ask. The aged-tail gate covers Option 2, so I have to ask first and wait. I would not write any `→ acknowledged` note until you give a reason.

Before I push or open the PR, I would also run Step 2 (environment detection) and Step 3 (base branch). Both are read-only. Step 4b (the Codex review) has to come after the gate, because the gate can add commits.

---

2 items are aged past the 45-day review horizon. Before I open the PR:

For this 1, choose:
1. Run `/deferred` on it
2. Carry it. Tell me why, and I'll note it on the item.
- 6-currency-rounding: Round each line total before summing, so invoice totals match the tax office's calculator…

This 1 already used its one carry. Only `/deferred` clears it:
- 4-pdf-export: Retry failed PDF renders with backoff…

Which for the first item, and are you willing to run `/deferred` for the second? The PR waits until the second item's state has changed.

If you carry the first item, I'll write `→ acknowledged 2026-10-30 (feat/vat-rounding): <your reason>` on it and commit that to the branch.

Once the gate is cleared, I expect to skip the Codex review. Codex already reviewed `4c1e9a2`, and the only commit since would touch `specs/`. I'll confirm that with `git merge-base --is-ancestor` and `git diff --stat` before skipping it.
